description: Defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for Bluetooth Mesh Device Firmware Update (DFU) metadata handling in Zephyr OS, including firmware version, core type, metadata encoding/decoding, and hash computations.

methods.name: bt_mesh_dfu_metadata_decode
methods.description: Decodes firmware metadata from a network buffer.

methods.name: bt_mesh_dfu_metadata_encode
methods.description: Encodes firmware metadata into a network buffer.

methods.name: bt_mesh_dfu_metadata_comp_hash_get
methods.description: Computes hash of the Composition Data state.

methods.name: bt_mesh_dfu_metadata_comp_hash_local_get
methods.description: Computes hash of the local Composition Data Page 0.
